title: Wealth Flow Systems
hook: I made more money than ever last year and somehow had nothing to show for it.
statement: Wealth comes from the gap between what comes in and what goes out, held over time. Not from income alone.
explainer: A big income with big expenses builds nothing. What matters is the net flow you keep and how long you keep it going. That's what actually stacks up.
sop: Track your real Income and Expense for one full month. No estimates.
Subtract Expense from Income, then multiply by Time to see the year.
Figure out how much of your income is recurring versus one-off.
Cut one recurring expense leak and send it to savings or investments.
Check your net flow monthly. The trend matters more than any one month.
equation_example: Income $8,000 a month, Expense $5,000, so you keep $3,000. Over 12 months that's $3,000 × 12 = $36,000. Higher means your net flow is actually building wealth. Lower or negative means spending is eating everything.
question: Write down your real monthly income minus expenses. Just the number.
closing_statement: Income that stops flowing was never wealth.
caption:
Principle Nº 150: Wealth Flow Systems

I made more money than ever last year and somehow had nothing to show for it.

Wealth comes from the gap between what comes in and what goes out, held over time. Not from income alone.
